canvas.$description: Root application/page background. The lowest structural surface, providing the backdrop for all other UI surfaces.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Root application/page background. The lowest structural surface, providing the backdrop for all other UI surfaces.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Cards, modal interiors, inputs, and floating overlays.

base.$description: Default content surface for cards, panels, and sections within the page. Provides a clean, solid background.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Default content surface for cards, panels, and sections within the page. Provides a clean, solid background.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Inputs, floating overlays, and components requiring a visually recessed surface.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis grouping within content surfaces, including alternate sections, section headers, list tracks, and secondary containers.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Low-emphasis grouping within content surfaces, including alternate sections, section headers, list tracks, and secondary containers.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Unfocused inputs, modals, and prominent floating surfaces. Not intended to establish strong separation.

raised.$description: Default opaque surface for dialogs, menus, popovers and floating toolbars; glass requires an explicit component choice and validated backdrop.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Default opaque surface for dialogs, menus, popovers and floating toolbars; glass requires an explicit component choice and validated backdrop.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Standard page content, cards, and input backgrounds. Do not use inverse color as an elevation treatment.

sunken.$description: Recessed surfaces within a parent container, including unfocused text fields, selects, textareas, editable regions, inset controls, and progress track s. Provides background separation without borders.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Recessed surfaces within a parent container, including unfocused text fields, selects, textareas, editable regions, inset controls, and progress track s. Provides background separation without borders.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Modals, cards, and floating overlays. Use ink.secondary for meaningful supporting text; reserve ink.tertiary for nonessential metadata.

inverse.$description: Intentionally high-contrast, solid neutral controls only, such as an explicitly emphasized neutral button.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Intentionally high-contrast, solid neutral controls only, such as an explicitly emphasized neutral button.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Popovers, tooltips, context menus, dropdowns, dialogs, floating selection/action toolbars, and notification containers. Never use inverse fill to signal elevation or floating position; use surface.raised and an elevation shadow instead. Also avoid general page surfaces, inputs, and brand actions.

modal.$description: Backdrop dimming behind a modal/dialog that blocks the underlying UI.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Backdrop dimming behind a modal/dialog that blocks the underlying UI.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Hover states, glass panels, or ordinary in-flow content backgrounds. @a11y Check effective dimming in each mode; scrim alone must not carry text.

primary.$description: Main text, values and labels on neutral surfaces; solid primary fills use rds.color.ink.on-brand.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Main text, values and labels on neutral surfaces; solid primary fills use rds.color.ink.on-brand.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Do not use on solid primary or brand fills; use rds.color.ink.on-brand there.

secondary.$description: Readable supporting text, including descriptions, helper text, notification content, and meaningful metadata. Provides clear hierarchy below primary text without compromising readability.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Readable supporting text, including descriptions, helper text, notification content, and meaningful metadata. Provides clear hierarchy below primary text without compromising readability.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Disabled states, decorative labels, and reducing contrast through additional opacity.

tertiary.$description: Low-emphasis text at full opacity on approved resting opaque surfaces; use secondary or primary ink on neutral hover/pressed overlays unless the complete treatment is separately validated.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Low-emphasis text at full opacity on approved resting opaque surfaces; use secondary or primary ink on neutral hover/pressed overlays unless the complete treatment is separately validated.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Essential descriptions, instructions, error messages, disabled states, and uncontrolled glass backgrounds. Do not apply additional opacity.

disabled.$description: Text/labels of genuinely disabled, noninteractive controls.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Text/labels of genuinely disabled, noninteractive controls.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Placeholder for an enabled input; not for text that remains actionable. @a11y Inactive controls can be exempt from WCAG text-contrast minimums, but state must also be programmatically exposed.

on-brand.$description: Text and icons on enabled solid primary fills across default, hover and pressed states.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Text and icons on enabled solid primary fills across default, hover and pressed states.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Do not use on soft brand-tinted backgrounds; use rds.color.brand.fg there. Disabled controls require their own validated treatment.

inverse.$description: Text/icons only on intentionally inverse neutral-solid controls.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Text/icons only on intentionally inverse neutral-solid controls.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Text/icons in floating UI containers (popovers, toolbars, menus, tooltips, dialogs); use ink.primary/secondary/tertiary on surface.raised instead. Not a general foreground role.

seed.$description: Immutable corporate identity reference, brand signatures and recipes that explicitly require the original brand seed in either appearance.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Immutable corporate identity reference, brand signatures and recipes that explicitly require the original brand seed in either appearance.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Applying raw seed indiscriminately to text or every clickable control.

default.$description: Selected/highlighted branded container, low-intensity emphasis panel, or soft brand control at rest.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Selected/highlighted branded container, low-intensity emphasis panel, or soft brand control at rest.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Mistaking a tinted plate for a solid primary call-to-action.

hover.$description: Pointer-hover state ONLY for an interactive brand.bg.default surface.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Pointer-hover state ONLY for an interactive brand.bg.default surface.
sourceAnnotations.avoid: Applying persistent hover tint to static brand panels or touch-only UI.

fg.$description: Branded text/icon emphasis on appropriate light/dark backgrounds, especially on brand.bg.default, soft brand controls and toned badges.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Branded text/icon emphasis on appropriate light/dark backgrounds, especially on brand.bg.default, soft brand controls and toned badges.

default.$description: Primary high-priority button/action background in its rest state.

hover.$description: Pointer-hover state on a currently enabled primary action.

pressed.$description: Temporary active/pressed feedback for enabled primary actions.

disabled.$description: Inactive solid primary control fill; interaction must be disabled too.

subtle.$description: Optional 1px separators in dense tables or between adjacent panels when spacing and surface contrast are insufficient.

control.$description: 1px boundary for enabled inputs, selects, or secondary controls only when their filled treatment needs a clearer affordance.

fg.$description: Link-colored text where an actual interactive hyperlink is present.

sourceAnnotations.usage: Link-colored text where an actual interactive hyperlink is present.
